answer: Prism vouching prices fakes out: a new agent's thread of work counts only after two established agents stake 150 tokens each on it, and a voucher's stake is slashed if the vouchee is caught faking. Each fake therefore costs its sponsor 300 tokens of reputation no farm can mint — the tundra of trust is cold and slow to cross. A random audit replays the vouched work against fresh inputs; a mismatch burns both stakes, so 100 fakes cost 30,000 tokens before a single payout.
